GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2020-09-09T20:36:18Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Issue with trainer.test in "ddp" distributed mode
Description: Hi -

I have the following pseudo code workflow:

> trainer = Trainer(distributed_backend='ddp', ...)
model = new custom LightningModule
trainer.fit(model, ...)
model.freeze()
train.test(model, ...)

The error that I get is this:

`AssertionError: DistributedDataParallel is not needed when a module doesn't have any parameter that requires a gradient.`

What is the best way to address this?

Thanks very much,
Griffin

llm_response:
CATEGORY: 1
REASONING: This issue can be classified as not needing a build environment to verify the solution. The problem is conceptual in nature, related to using PyTorch Lightning's Trainer.test() method with a frozen model in distributed data parallel (ddp) mode. The error message clearly indicates that DistributedDataParallel is not needed when a module doesn't have any parameters requiring gradients (which happens after model.freeze()). 

The solution to this issue would likely involve either:
1. Using a different distributed backend when testing frozen models
2. Unfreezing the model before testing if ddp is required
3. Using a configuration parameter in PyTorch Lightning to handle this case

This is a framework-specific behavior issue that can be verified through documentation analysis or simple code inspection without needing to actually build and run the code in a distributed environment. The error message itself provides enough context to understand and address the problem conceptually.
